title: Draw what's here
subtitle: No words needed — just a shape.

steps.body:
Some things don't have words yet.

Before you try to name it — let your hand move. A shape, a scribble, a colour of feeling. There's no right way, and no one else sees it.

steps.title: What's here, as a shape?
steps.body: Let your hand find it. Stop whenever it feels done.

steps.title: If a word wanted to come now, what would it be?
steps.body: Only if one does — the drawing is enough on its own.
steps.placeholder: A word, or leave it blank…

exit.body: You gave it a shape before words could pin it down. That's a real way of knowing.[[ What you called it: {subject}.]]
